tithi.title: Tithi (Lunar Day)
tithi.desc: A Tithi is a lunar day, calculated by the time it takes for the longitudinal angle between the Moon and the Sun to increase by 12 degrees.

nakshatra.title: Nakshatra (Lunar Mansion)
nakshatra.desc: A Nakshatra is a sector along the ecliptic. There are 27 Nakshatras, each representing a segment of the moon's path.

yoga.title: Yoga
yoga.desc: Yoga is calculated by adding the longitudes of the Sun and Moon and dividing by 13°20'. It represents the relationship between the Sun and Moon.

karana.title: Karana
karana.desc: A Karana is half of a Tithi (6 degrees of separation). There are 11 different Karanas.

paksha.title: Paksha (Lunar Fortnight)
paksha.desc: Shukla Paksha is the waxing moon phase (bright fortnight), and Krishna Paksha is the waning moon phase (dark fortnight).

rahuKaal.title: Rahu Kaal
rahuKaal.desc: An inauspicious period of the day, ruled by Rahu. It is generally avoided for starting new, important activities.

abhijit.title: Abhijit Muhurat
abhijit.desc: An extremely auspicious period in the middle of the day, capable of destroying numerous doshas (flaws).

vara.title: Vara (Weekday)
vara.desc: The solar weekday, measured traditionally from local sunrise to the next day's sunrise. Each weekday has a ruling planetary deity.
